core_conclusion: 实际未来命令在总体及高控制变化组均降低三项主要动力学预测误差，支持其具有增量预测信息。
results_paragraph: At the nominal 500 ms horizon, replaying the logged future commands reduced velocity RMSE from 0.4327 to 0.3573 m/s (17.43%), attitude geodesic RMS error from 4.7007° to 4.0784° (13.24%), and body-rate RMSE from 0.6439 to 0.5966 rad/s (7.34%) compared with holding the origin command. All three seeds favored actual-command replay on these aggregate metrics. After averaging seeds within each flight, the improvement direction was also consistent across all 17 validation flights. In the high-control-change subset (454 origins spanning all 17 flights), the corresponding reductions were 16.92%, 17.58% and 7.48%. These findings support incremental predictive information from future logged commands within the observed flight distribution; they do not imply improvement for every individual trajectory.
